title: Abstractive Text Summarization using Sequence-to-sequence RNNs and Beyond

numbers.sentence: We used the scripts made available by the authors of this work to preprocess the data, which resulted in about 3.8M training examples.
We used Adadelta for training, with an initial learning rate of 0.001.

For all our models, we employ the large-vocabulary trick, where we restrict the decoder vocabulary size to 2,000 , because it cuts down the training time per epoch by nearly three times, and helps this and all subsequent models converge in only 50%-75% of the epochs needed for the model based on full vocabulary.

All models typically converged within 15 epochs using our early stopping criterion based on the validation cost.
While the flat models ( words-lvt2k and words-lvt2k-ptr) took under 5 hours per epoch, the hierarchical attention model was very expensive, consuming nearly 12.5 hours per epoch.
